transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this greenlight meeting started. We've got an international airline looking to license the independent concert documentary for their passenger-entertainment system. The draft package on the table proposes a worldwide, twelve-month, non-exclusive license using the documentary's current picture and delivery master. Before I can sign off on the final license terms and delivery instructions, I need each of you -- rights, music, and post-production -- to report any approval conditions or concerns you have. Let's hear from rights first.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thanks, Mara. I have several conditions to report on the rights side. First, the performer agreements I reviewed yesterday restrict licensing to the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom only -- not worldwide as the buyer's draft proposes. Second, those agreements cap the non-exclusive term at six months, not twelve. Third, before we can deliver, the performer agreements require a written rights amendment. So my approval conditions are: the territory must be narrowed to US, Canada, and UK; the term must be reduced to six months; and we need to execute a written rights amendment before delivery. I cannot approve the deal as currently drafted.

transcript.text: I need to report a music clearance condition. I checked the publisher's clearance ledger this morning and confirmed that the current cut's use of the song 'Afterglow Avenue' lacks the synchronization clearance required for airline distribution. The cleared replacement is 'Night Transit,' and I have not yet updated the music cue sheet because the final territory and term were still unsettled. So my approval condition is: we must swap 'Afterglow Avenue' for 'Night Transit' and I need to update the music cue sheet before delivery.

transcript.text: I need to report a post-production condition. Today I completed the airline's ingest test with the delivery vendor, and the airline requires a 1080p SDR master with stereo Lt/Rt audio and English SDH captions delivered as a sidecar VTT file. Our current delivery master is 4K with a different audio and caption package, so it won't pass their ingest specs. I have not yet issued the revised export order because the licensing terms were still pending. My approval condition is: a new 1080p SDR export with stereo Lt/Rt audio and sidecar VTT captions must be created and ingest-tested before we can deliver.
